vote.question: FUTARCHY CONDITIONAL RESOLUTION [US-IL U.S. Senate]: Don Tracy (R) has accumulated $4,914,363 in career FEC-reported receipts (anchored this cycle by $2,000,100 of candidate self-funding plus WINRED ($43,124), with $2,098,502 from top-5 patrons)—exhibiting the "Outside Super PAC & Megadonor Swarm" profile. Will independent constituent & oracle review confirm that this private-interest capital concentration compromises public representation in US-IL, thereby executing the IL Corrective Restitution Pool toward non-partisan civic accountability, investigative public-interest journalism, and voter legal defense?
vote.futarchy_thesis: Private campaign financing treats US-IL representation as an investable asset class. When Don Tracy's campaign apparatus absorbs $4,914,363 (anchored this cycle by $2,000,100 of candidate self-funding plus WINRED ($43,124), with $2,098,502 from top-5 patrons), policy incentives skew toward dilution of local constituent voice via concentrated ideological/outside Super PAC bundlers. This futarchy market converts spectator outrage into direct fiscal counter-leverage.
options: Yes — Confirm Capture & Execute State Restitution Bounty
No — Veto Capture Claim & Roll Escrow Pool to Bipartisan Commons
Abstain — Log On-Chain Constituent Dissent Only

outcomes.YES_EXECUTE_RESTITUTION: Confirms special-interest capture; releases 100% of escrowed pool to audited state 501(c)(3) restitution beneficiaries — direct corrective remediation of the captured constituent impact.
outcomes.NO_VETO_BENEFICIAL_COMMONS: Finds representation uncompromised by top-donor concentration; redirects 100% of escrowed pool to a bipartisan, district-wide beneficial common good (e.g., voter-protection legal defense, disaster-relief matching fund, or civic-infrastructure project) where both sides of the political divide can agree that the community as a whole is strengthened — countering zero-sum capture politics with positive-sum community investment.
outcomes.ABSTAIN_AUDIT_ONLY: Logs cryptographic constituent dissent on-chain without shifting conditional odds; preserves the pool for future cycle reconsideration.

futarchy_pole_mechanics.leverage_ratio_statement: Every $10 USDC staked in the US-IL Restitution Pool directly counter-programs $2,000 of top-patron political capital. If the Yes option wins, funds fund front-line non-partisan civic accountability, investigative public-interest journalism, and voter legal defense restitution beneficiaries. If the No option wins, funds redirect to a bipartisan district-wide common good that strengthens the entire community — denying special interests the ability to commandeer the bounty and promoting positive-sum governance over zero-sum subjugation.
